none: PAS NLM-B78614: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus, possibly a copy, of House of Constantine (306-361) Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Heavily cleaned and legend lost. Reve4rse description: Two soldiers with [probably] two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, though suggesting one standard rather than two. Diameter: 15.4mm, Weight: 1.22gms, die axis: 6
